Diagnostic evidence only; do not merge this branch.

The corrected full working tree `6b39988faf4d1d2a590d037854d817e699fd6817` passed all 1,441 declared Native steps before the replacement seasonal feature commits. All 10 diagnostic Native sections passed; the immutable coverage qualification retains its actual local/cloud partition identities and verifies every residue exactly once. All six predefined benchmark allocations finished. Actual EPYC 7763/4 allocations 3, 5 and 6 pass every original stock desktop cap with zero page errors; allocations 1, 2 and 4 stopped on unsupported EPYC 9V74/4 before source or timing.

The app commits were authored at exactly the complete qualified tree, then integrated through the normal PR-lap process over newer Dev building and release-panel changes, preserving the original feature edits and all upstream liberty values. The integrated committed preflight passes. [Raw source, Native, calibration and integrated preflight](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/tree/main/evidence/vegetation-realism-2026-11-25/candidate-2026-11-26/roughness-channel-qualified-source).

The corrected application has merged through [PR #2414](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/pull/2414), actual Dev squash [`c18420c46b94c00989affc1cfdb243a1d12bb114`](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/commit/c18420c46b94c00989affc1cfdb243a1d12bb114). Its exact current feature head is `e4ec8d6b65022738f70273ce16481e96d145423c`; the actual merged tree matches the qualified source. All 13 workflows passed: the [full combined Native gate](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/actions/runs/46119797196), all 15 published browser sections at both widths (1,565 assertions, zero failures/page errors), human/moving/upload regressions, and all 15 stock reports. The [actual first desktop navigation failure and one unchanged successful retry](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/tree/main/evidence/vegetation-realism-2026-11-25/candidate-2026-11-26/dev-2423-desktop-navigation-negative) remain distinct; no old-source pass is relabelled current.

Closed unmerged as intended. The historical diagnostic results and their source/calibration identity remain in the evidence linked above; the application landed only through #2414. T-3747, T-3748 and T-3760 are done.
